title: An unsuccessful alternative-employment search can coexist with an ordered remedy and no restored work
source_unit: Primary Fair Work Commission decision [2024] FWC 3523, IAA work-from-home employment case

observations.period: July 8, 2024–January 17, 2025; dismissal, unsuccessful job search, and compensation deadline

denominator.unit: publicly identified adjudicated worker case; no population denominator

assessed_lost_income.unit: Australian dollars for eight weeks before notice-pay deduction

notice_pay_deduction.unit: weeks of pay deducted from assessed loss

compensation_order.unit: Australian dollars gross less tax plus 11.5% superannuation, payable by 2025-01-17

reinstatement.value: declined as unworkable after relationship breakdown

payment_receipt_and_later_work.unit: missing execution, receipt, net recovery, household, and post-order employment evidence

observations.method: Structured extraction from the primary Fair Work Commission decision and linked order reference; dismissal process, unsuccessful search, assessed income loss, compensation order, and non-reinstatement are kept separate from payment and later recovery.
observations.uncertainty: One case cannot estimate dismissal, alternative-work, unemployment, remedy, or payment rates. The public decision does not retain full search intensity, offer set, household effects, health/time costs, payment receipt, later employment, trust, recurrence, or exit.
observations.subgroup: One work-from-home employee dismissed during a redundancy-related dispute without meaningful consultation or an opportunity to explore redeployment.
observations.counterinterpretation: A worker may actively search without securing acceptable work; an ordered compensation route can recognize lost income while leaving the original job, payment, and durable security unresolved.

related_sources.claim: Official Fair Work Commission decision and order search route.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: The hash covers the committed project ledger containing the bounded primary decision extraction.
reproduction_audit.access_boundary: The public decision reports unsuccessful alternative-employment search and an order but no later payment, household recovery, employment, trust, recurrence, action, switching, or exit record.

boundary: This record adds one primary adjudicated case with unsuccessful alternative-employment search, assessed income loss, non-reinstatement, and an ordered remedy. It does not establish payment receipt, household recovery, durable work, prevalence, trust, recurrence, collective action, switching, or exit.
